About

I am a Bachelor's degree holder in Graphics Communication and Design and a multi-artistic person, covering everything from visuals to performing arts. I design flyers, social media posts, logos, branding, company profiles and apparel for businesses, organisations and events. I also make crafts and interior decor by hand, with prior knowledge of 2D animation and AI.
